prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Fallback flows during adoption (new_flow) were helpful (+8.0%).
Interactive wait screen tips and status (wait_info) were helpful (+5.1%), but other wait screen updates like progress bars or notification alerts showed no clear effect.
Sign-in changes, including reassurance hints and reordering steps, showed no clear effect.
Finish step changes, including copy updates, new verification screens, and layout changes, showed no clear effect.
Redesigns during path selection and adoption steps showed no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimated measured impact across tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +8.0% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -3.8% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -1.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +5.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, layout: +6.3% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -5.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.2% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 62.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Multi-Preset Pet Selection Carousel Fallback: Adds an automated fallback carousel of curated pet archetypes when custom photo processing or rendering hits potential errors during adoption. (why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (62.7% conversion, 1017s mean time) and support reported issues where custom pet creation fails.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Compact Carousel Pet Selector with Breed Badges: Redesigns the pet picker screen into a compact carousel layout displaying breed badges and animated previews to speed up choices. (why: Adoption conversion is low (62.7%) with a high median decision time of 89s.)
2: [home, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Launch Status Screen: Inserts a dedicated launch readiness screen after waiting that verifies desktop overlay permissions before completing setup. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting pets not appearing on desktop or the app failing to open upon onboarding completion.)
3: [home, wait_info] Background Generation Minimization Hint: Displays a clear hint on the waiting screen explaining that the app can be safely minimized while generating the pet. (why: The median home wait time is 201s (mean 2336s), leading to user anxiety and drop-off while waiting for generation.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Control Callout Card: Adds explicit instructions on the final screen explaining how to summon, hide, and interact with the desktop pet using hotkeys. (why: Support received 3 emails post-onboarding asking how to control, hide, or talk to their pet on the desktop.)
5: [sign_in, layout] Compact Single-Column Sign-In Layout: Reorganizes the sign-in screen into a clean compact layout focusing on quick single-click account creation. (why: Sign-in loses 27.1% of users and has high mean time (567s). Support reported 8 cases of account sign-in confusion.)
6: [home, notification] Completion Sound Notification Toggle: Adds a completion sound toggle button on the wait screen so users hear an audio chime when pet generation finishes. (why: Mean wait time is 2336s, causing users to switch away from the app and forget onboarding status.)

scores.note: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate (37.3%) and support confirms creation errors; fallback flows are proven effective (+8.0%).
Target step drops 37.3% of users, but redesigns in adoption previously showed negative impact (-3.8%) and lack support ticket evidence.
Home drop-off is relatively low (15.0%); introducing new screens typically adds friction and lacks positive precedent.
Home step has extreme wait times; wait_info changes consistently improve conversion (+2.2% to +5.1%) and can be shipped via config.
Finish step drops 35.2% of users and support reports post-onboarding confusion, though finish step copy changes show mixed overall evidence.
Sign-in drops 27.1% and has 8 support cases, but historical sign-in layout/step modifications showed no clear positive effect.
Addresses long home wait times, but notification/sound alert wait screen updates previously showed no clear effect.
